overview: The Medford Historical Commission held public hearings on several demolition applications, voting to declare 28 Grove Street preferably preserved and finding 222 Boston Avenue historically significant. The board also voted on multiple significance determinations, accepted three new demolition applications, and discussed ongoing preservation projects.

items.title: 28 Grove Street Preferably Preserved Hearing
items.summary: The commission voted to declare 28 Grove Street preferably preserved, imposing an 18-month demolition delay while referring the project to a subcommittee to work with the owner.

items.title: 91 Winchester Street Continuation
items.summary: The commission continued the hearing for 91 Winchester Street to the following month because required fees and site postings were incomplete.

items.title: 1 Clematis Road Significance Determination
items.summary: The commission voted to pass on review for 1 Clematis Road due to an unsubmitted consultant report, allowing the demolition permit process to proceed.

items.title: 67 North Street Significance Determination
items.summary: A motion to find 67 North Street historically significant failed, determining the property not significant.

items.title: 236 Boston Avenue Significance Determination
items.summary: The commission voted that 236 Boston Avenue is not historically significant.

items.title: 222 Boston Avenue Significance Determination
items.summary: The commission voted that 222 Boston Avenue is historically significant, scheduling a preferably preserved hearing for the next meeting.

items.title: New Demolition Applications and Form B Funding
items.summary: The commission accepted demolition applications for 12 George Street, 28 Winter Street, and 17 Green Road, approving $1,500 to commission Form B historical reports for the properties.

items.title: Commission Business and Updates
items.summary: The commission approved the February 2023 meeting minutes, discussed a site plan review for 200 Boston Avenue, and reviewed updates on local survey grants and CPA projects.
